works.title: Oracle
works.description: A knowledge-access system that disrupts institutional silos and gatekeeping by combining AI-powered research with moral-ledger analysis. Designed to operate at civilizational scale, showing who benefits and who pays in every decision, with plural voice (representing collective humanity) rather than individual authority. Includes safeguards, governance models, and appeals processes.
works.quote: You're writing a whole book to be redundant to Oracle. What's the point?
